steps.command:
ssh yyf@10.2.32.14 'cd /home/yyf/project/image_agent_releases/codex-es-hybrid-runtime-probe-rootfix10-20260619T154306Z/apps/api && PYTHONPATH=. /home/yyf/project/image_agent/apps/api/.venv/bin/python - <<"PY"
from pathlib import Path
from app.agent.status import rebuild_rag_index, rag_status
def is_true(value):
    return value is True or str(value).lower() == "true"
def positive_int(value):
    try:
        return int(value) > 0
    except (TypeError, ValueError):
        return False
def require(condition, marker):
    if not condition:
        raise SystemExit(marker)
root = Path("/home/yyf/project/image_agent")
rebuild = rebuild_rag_index(root).get("hybrid_search") or {}
status = rag_status(root).get("index", {}).get("hybrid_search") or {}
require(is_true(rebuild.get("configured")) and is_true(status.get("configured")), "configured=true")
require(rebuild.get("mode") == "connected" and status.get("mode") == "connected", "mode=connected")
require(is_true(rebuild.get("persisted")) and is_true(status.get("persisted")), "persisted=true")
require(positive_int(rebuild.get("indexed_chunk_count")) and positive_int(status.get("indexed_chunk_count")), "indexed_chunk_count>0")
require(is_true(rebuild.get("embedding_production_ready")) and is_true(status.get("embedding_production_ready")), "embedding_production_ready=true")
require(not rebuild.get("error") and not status.get("error"), "error absent")
require(not rebuild.get("embedding_error") and not status.get("embedding_error"), "embedding_error absent")
print("configured=true")
print("mode=connected")
print("persisted=true")
print("indexed_chunk_count>0")
print("embedding_production_ready=true")
print("error absent")
print("embedding_error absent")
PY'
